name: Sinopec Oilfield Equipment Corporation
summary: Sinopec Oilfield Equipment Corp. engages in the manufacture and sale of petroleum and natural gas and mining drill bits & petroleum machinery accessories. Its products include drilling, oil gas engineering, ground construction, energy saving and new energy equipment. It also provides marketing and network services. The company was founded on September 28, 1998 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
